limits: End-to-end timings are three fresh-process repeats. Startup and IO dominate these short runs.
Planner and driver timings are from separate diagnostic builds. The extra scans warm caches, so phase timings do not establish a production break-even threshold.
Fixed-seed repeats do not estimate sampling uncertainty. Concentration differences have no independent accuracy oracle.
Actual source-minimum particle allocation can exceed the requested budget. The current planner uses TAUS*TPS as its target.
Fresh-emission mass checks do not establish a full-domain mass balance.
Auto mode is a proposal; no PR implementation was changed.
